title: 第21章 冰火相容第22章 猎手联盟
content_zh:
“三命轮？”陆安越听越不明白了，不由得问道，“不是说命轮随着血脉而来吗，我为什么会有三个？”
“事无绝对，我问你，如果你的父亲有命轮，你的母亲也有命轮，那又如何？”黑雾之人反问。
陆安一怔，跟着皱眉沉思起来。
“择优而取。”黑雾之人并没有拖沓，直接答道，“命轮有强弱之分，传承的血脉也有强弱之分，所以一般来说都是择优而取。”
“你的父亲拥有强大的命轮，你的母亲也有命轮，但事实上并没有你的父亲强大。但命轮到底传承哪一家并不是刚出生就决定的，而是在三岁之前慢慢形成。也就是说，刚出生的你，其实本身还是个未知数。”
“所以，我也给了你一个命轮。”黑雾之人说道，语不惊人死不休。
“什么？”陆安一愣，有些错愕问道，“命轮不是与血脉有关吗？怎么会说给就给？”
“我说了，事无绝对，永远不要认为每件事只有一条路可以走。当你强大到一定地步的时候，自然一切都可以随心所欲。”黑雾之人沧桑的声音显得很平静，仿佛自己做的事情并不值得称赞。
“一般来说，即便我给了你一个命轮，你体内同时拥有三种不同的命轮，到最后还是择优而取，一个人是不可以拥有那么多能力。但你不同，你需要感谢一个人，那就是你的母亲。”
“母亲？”陆安念着这个词，显得有些陌生。他从未见过自己的娘亲长什么样子，更没有与娘亲有过任何记忆。
“没错。”黑雾之人点头说道，“她的命轮很奇特，拥有强大的镇压之力，但这种镇压更像是包容，再加上她临死前的抉择，通过献祭的方式保护你，两者相加，才让你父亲的命轮和我给你的命轮完美同存一体，并且不会伤害到你。”
献祭……
陆安听着这个陌生的词，虽然他不知道这代表什么，但一定是一个痛苦折磨的过程。
刚刚知道自己还有着亲生父母的他就听到母亲死亡的噩耗，这对他来说，是一种沉痛的打击，哪怕他与母亲从未见过。
“我娘……她叫什么？坟墓在哪？”陆安轻轻问道，声音有些颤抖。
“她叫陆婷，至于坟墓的话……”黑袍之人顿了顿，说道，“献祭是不会留下任何尸首的。”
“……”陆安身体一震，抬起头看向师父，问道，“那我爹呢？”
“你爹？”不知怎的，黑雾之人露出一抹冷笑，让陆安很诧异，说道，“你爹是谁我不会告诉你，但我可以告诉你他还活着。等你足够强大之后就会遇到他，到时候，你娘的事情自己去问他吧。”
陆安看着师父，他再傻也不会听不出这里有很多故事，便深吸一口气，点了点头。
“你的身世我只能说这么多，更多的需要你自己去寻找。接下来，我就要好好讲一下你的命轮了。”黑雾之人说道。

陆安一听，也连忙收拾情绪，皱紧眉头，认真听着黑雾之人的教导。
“你体内的三命轮，首先说你母亲的命轮，在我的命轮你父亲的命轮双重压力下，这命轮并不明显，甚至不能主动释放，但也会给你极大的好处，最明显的就是让冰火相容。”黑雾之人快速说道。
陆安一怔，下意识问道，“冰火相容是什么意思？”
“冰，就是你父亲传承给你的命轮。”黑雾之人说道，“现在，我来引导你将其释放出来。”
说着，只见一条黑雾从黑雾之人的身体中分割出来，直奔陆安胸口，瞬间没入消失不见。
顿时，陆安感觉到身体充满力量，甚至要身体要爆炸一样，五脏六腑都在顶着肌肉。就在此时，只听黑雾之人说道，“现在，抬起你的手，张开手心，我会引导你的冰出现，仔细感受体内气流的流动，这就是你释放命轮的方法。”
陆安闻言，连忙认真感受起体内。果然，有一股气流自心脏涌出，大部分涌向丹田之处，再由丹田周转一圈后，涌到手心。
刹那间，陆安便见到在自己的手心之上，一块散发着无尽寒意的冰骤然出现！这冰晶在手中安静悬浮着，美丽至极。
“冰，并非什么奇特的事物，甚至绝大部分天师都可以将天元变成冰的样子。”黑雾之人开口，为陆安解释道，“但是，越是平常的形态，想变幻起来越为高深。你的冰，与普通的冰不同，是‘玄深寒冰’。”
content_en:
"Three life wheels?" Lu An became more and more confused as he listened, and couldn't help but ask, "Didn't it mean that life wheels come with blood? Why do I have three of them?"
"There are no absolutes. Let me ask you, if your father has a life wheel and your mother also has a life wheel, so what?" the man in the black mist asked.
Lu An was startled, then frowned and began to think.
"Take the best." The man of the black mist did not delay and answered directly, "The life wheel has strong and weak points, and the inherited bloodline also has strong and weak points, so generally speaking, we choose the best."
"Your father has a powerful Life Wheel, and your mother also has a Life Wheel, but in fact it is not as powerful as your father. But which family the Life Wheel will be inherited from is not decided upon birth, but is slowly formed before the age of three. In other words, when you are just born, you are actually still unknown."
"So, I also gave you a life wheel." The man of the black mist said, without saying anything surprising.
"What?" Lu An was stunned and asked in astonishment, "Isn't the life wheel related to blood? How come you just give it to me?"
"I said, there are no absolutes. Never think that there is only one way to go for everything. When you are strong enough, you can naturally do whatever you want." The man of black mist's vicissitudes of voice sounded very calm, as if what he did was not worthy of praise.
"Generally speaking, even if I give you a life wheel, and you have three different life wheels in your body at the same time, in the end you still have to choose the best. One person cannot have so many abilities. But you are different. You need to thank one person, and that is your mother."
"Mother?" Lu An said this word, which seemed a bit unfamiliar. He had never seen what his mother looked like, and he had no memories of her.
"That's right." The man of the black mist nodded and said, "Her life wheel is very strange and has strong suppressive power, but this kind of suppression is more like tolerance. Coupled with her decision before her death, she protected you through sacrifice. The combination of the two makes your father's life wheel and the life wheel I gave you perfectly coexist and will not hurt you."
Sacrifice...
Lu An listened to this unfamiliar word. Although he didn't know what it meant, it must be a painful and torturous process.
He had just learned that he still had biological parents when he heard the sad news of his mother's death. This was a painful blow to him, even though he and his mother had never met.
"My mother... what's her name? Where is the grave?" Lu An asked softly, his voice trembling.
"Her name is Lu Ting. As for the tomb..." The man in black robe paused and said, "No corpse will be left behind in the sacrifice."
"..." Lu An's body trembled, he raised his head and looked at his master, and asked, "What about my father?"
"Your father?" For some reason, the man of the black mist showed a sneer, which surprised Lu An, and said, "I won't tell you who your father is, but I can tell you that he is still alive. You will meet him when you are strong enough. Then you can ask him about your mother."
Lu An looked at his master. No matter how stupid he was, he would not fail to hear that there were many stories here, so he took a deep breath and nodded.
"I can only tell you so much about your life experience. You need to find more by yourself. Next, I will talk about your life wheel." The man of the black mist said.
When Lu An heard this, he quickly collected his emotions, frowned, and listened carefully to the teachings of the man of the black mist.
"The three life wheels in your body, first of all, your mother's life wheel. Under the dual pressure of my life wheel and your father's life wheel, this life wheel is not obvious and cannot even be actively released, but it will also give you great benefits. The most obvious one is to make ice and fire compatible." The man of the black mist said quickly.
Lu An was startled and asked subconsciously, "What does it mean to be compatible with ice and fire?"
"Ice is the life wheel passed down to you by your father." The man of the black mist said, "Now, I will guide you to release it.come out. "
As he said that, he saw a line of black mist split from the body of the man in the black mist, and went straight to Lu An's chest, disappearing in an instant.
Suddenly, Lu An felt that his body was full of power, even as if his body was going to explode, and his internal organs were pressing against his muscles. At this moment, the man of the black mist said, "Now, raise your hand, open your palm, I will guide your ice to appear, and carefully feel the flow of air in your body. This is how you release your life wheel. "
Hearing this, Lu An quickly felt the inside of his body seriously. Sure enough, there was a flow of air coming out of the heart, most of it flowing towards the Dantian. Then it circulated around the Dantian and flowed into the palm of the hand.
In an instant, Lu An saw a piece of ice exuding endless chill suddenly appear on the palm of his hand! This ice crystal floats quietly in the hand, extremely beautiful.
"Ice is not a strange thing, even most heavenly masters can turn Tianyuan into the form of ice. "The man in the black mist spoke and explained to Lu An, "However, the more ordinary the form, the more advanced it is to change it. Your ice is different from ordinary ice, it is 'mysterious ice'. "
